description: This file defines the class SugarRestRSS, which implements a REST protocol for generating RSS feeds related to SugarCRM/SuiteCRM entity data. It serializes input data into RSS XML format, providing methods to generate the RSS response, items, headers, and handle faults.

classes.name: SugarRestRSS
classes.description: A class implementing a REST protocol that serializes data into RSS format for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Serializes the input object and outputs an RSS feed or triggers a fault if 'entry_list' is missing.

methods.name: generateResponseHeader
methods.description: Outputs the beginning of the RSS XML with channel info.

methods.name: generateItems
methods.description: Iterates over 'entry_list' items and calls generateItem for each.

methods.name: generateItem
methods.description: Generates an individual RSS item from the provided data.

methods.name: generateResponseFooter
methods.description: Outputs the closing tags of the RSS feed.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Returns a fault indicating RSS is not an acceptable input type.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Outputs an error item in the RSS feed with error details.
